message.plaguecore.victory: The Heart has fallen. The land breathes.
plaguecore.health.body.arms.0: My arms obey me as always.
plaguecore.health.body.arms.1: My arms feel a bit heavier than usual.
plaguecore.health.body.arms.2: There's weakness in my arms. Work is harder now.
plaguecore.health.body.arms.3: My arms barely hold anything. Tools just slip out.
plaguecore.health.body.arms.4: Sometimes my hands do something I didn't tell them to.
plaguecore.health.body.head.0: My head is clear. Thinking comes easy.
plaguecore.health.body.head.1: I think I'm a bit tired. Thoughts come slower.
plaguecore.health.body.head.2: There's a heaviness in my head. It's hard to concentrate.
plaguecore.health.body.head.3: My thoughts have gone strangely slow. I can barely understand what's happening to me.
plaguecore.health.body.head.4: I'm no longer sure I'm fully in control of myself.
plaguecore.health.body.legs.0: My legs are strong, walking is easy.
plaguecore.health.body.legs.1: There's some tiredness in my legs now.
plaguecore.health.body.legs.2: My legs feel heavier somehow. Running doesn't work anymore.
plaguecore.health.body.legs.3: My legs barely hold me up. Every step is an effort.
plaguecore.health.body.legs.4: I don't remember how I ended up wherever they carried me.
plaguecore.health.body.torso.0: Breathing is easy, nothing bothers me.
plaguecore.health.body.torso.1: Sometimes it gets hard to take a full breath.
plaguecore.health.body.torso.2: There's a heaviness in my chest, and I keep wanting to cough.
plaguecore.health.body.torso.3: Every breath is a struggle. Coughing tears at my chest.
plaguecore.health.body.torso.4: It feels like something's moving inside me on its own.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.arms.0: My arms are steady, nothing worth noting.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.arms.1: The heaviness in my arms is even, no trembling — ordinary tiredness, nothing worse.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.arms.2: The weakness comes from the shoulder, not the wrist. That happens when the body spends its strength elsewhere.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.arms.3: My arms don't hold anything at all. This isn't tiredness anymore.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.arms.4: My arms move on their own, and that's different from just not obeying me — the second one is worse.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.head.0: My head is clear, no heaviness, no distraction — nothing to worry about.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.head.1: Thoughts come a bit slower, but I don't lose the thread — ordinary fatigue.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.head.2: The heaviness sits at the back of my head all day and doesn't let go even when I rest. Plain tiredness doesn't press like that.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.head.3: My thoughts break off mid-sentence. This isn't just tiredness, something is getting in the way of my thinking.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.head.4: The gaps in my memory don't come from lack of sleep but from something inside — I can feel it, even if I can't explain it.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.legs.0: My legs are strong, my stride even — no tiredness in them at all.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.legs.1: The heaviness in my legs comes and goes with each step, never lingering — ordinary strain.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.legs.2: The heaviness in my legs doesn't go away even after resting. This isn't from walking.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.legs.3: My legs fail me even on flat ground. It isn't the muscles.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.legs.4: I walk, and then I don't remember how I got here. My legs carry me on their own.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.torso.0: Breathing is free, my chest gives no trouble.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.torso.1: My breath catches only on the climb, not at rest — ordinary shortness of breath, so far.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.torso.2: The cough comes from deep in my chest, not the throat. Dust alone doesn't do that.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.torso.3: My chest heaves even when I'm standing still. The breathing is off, and not from effort.
plaguecore.health.cleric.body.torso.4: Something inside moves on its own, without my will. I'm not imagining it.
plaguecore.health.cleric.other.body.arms: His arms hold steady, nothing concerning.
The heaviness in his movements is even, no twitching — ordinary tiredness.
His arms look weak. He barely uses them the way he normally would.
He can't hold onto anything for more than a moment. This isn't tiredness from work.
His hands twitch on their own, separate from whatever he's doing.
plaguecore.health.cleric.other.body.head: His eyes are clear, he answers right away and to the point.
He answers a bit slower than usual, but he doesn't lose his train of thought.
He looks past me for long stretches, as if listening to something inside himself.
He loses his train of thought mid-sentence. Ordinary tiredness doesn't confuse a man like that.
Sometimes he looks at me as if he doesn't recognize where he is.
plaguecore.health.cleric.other.body.legs: He stands firm, his stride even and sure.
He favors one leg slightly with every step, but still walks freely.
He favors his legs even where the walking is easy. It isn't the road.
He can barely drag his feet even on flat ground.
He moves in jerks, as if his legs carry him on their own, without his will.
plaguecore.health.cleric.other.body.tors: He breathes evenly, his chest shows no trouble.
His breathing only catches after exertion, not before.
His cough comes from deep in the chest, not the throat. That isn't from dust.
His chest heaves even at rest. The breathing is off, and not from effort.
His chest heaves for no reason I can see from the outside.
plaguecore.health.cleric.other.overall.0: He looks healthy, and I see nothing hidden underneath.
plaguecore.health.cleric.other.overall.1: His tiredness is ordinary, surface-deep — the body is handling it on its own.
plaguecore.health.cleric.other.overall.2: His breathing is heavy, his skin dry. It seems he's getting worse.
plaguecore.health.cleric.other.overall.3: His body is holding on by sheer will, and it shows in everything at once.
plaguecore.health.cleric.other.overall.4: He's still on his feet, but I don't understand how — the body should have given out long ago.
plaguecore.health.edit.title: Editing condition
plaguecore.health.edit.hidden: The player sees their own here — it does not reach you.
plaguecore.health.feel.absorption: Something is taking the hit for me.
plaguecore.health.feel.darkness: Darkness seems to cling to my eyes.
plaguecore.health.feel.fire_resistance: Heat doesn't scare me right now.
plaguecore.health.feel.glowing: I feel like I'm giving off light.
plaguecore.health.feel.health_boost: I have more strength in me than usual right now.
plaguecore.health.feel.hunger: I want to eat more often than usual.
plaguecore.health.feel.invisibility: It's like no one notices me.
plaguecore.health.feel.jump_boost: My legs spring on their own.
plaguecore.health.feel.levitation: The ground is slipping out from under my feet.
plaguecore.health.feel.nausea: I feel sick, and everything's swimming before my eyes.
plaguecore.health.feel.night_vision: I can see unexpectedly clearly in the dark.
plaguecore.health.feel.none: I notice nothing unusual about myself.
plaguecore.health.feel.regeneration: I feel better with every minute that passes.
plaguecore.health.feel.saturation: I'm full for a long while.
plaguecore.health.feel.slow_falling: For some reason, I'm falling softly.
plaguecore.health.feel.slowness: It's hard for me to move.
plaguecore.health.feel.water_breathing: It feels like I could go without breathing for a very long time.
plaguecore.health.feel.weakness: My arms feel heavier than usual.
plaguecore.health.feel.wither: It's like my strength is draining away.
plaguecore.health.hint.pick: Click on the body to listen to yourself.
plaguecore.health.hud.4: I no longer understand what's happening to me
plaguecore.health.hunger.2: I want to eat more often than usual.
plaguecore.health.hunger.3: I don't feel like eating yet.
plaguecore.health.intrusion.2: THESE ARE NOT YOUR HANDS ANYMORE
plaguecore.health.intrusion.4: YOU ARE NOT ALONE IN HERE
plaguecore.health.mark.fracture.name: Fracture
plaguecore.health.mark.fracture.self: The bone gives under me. Every movement shoots pain up to the shoulder.
plaguecore.health.mark.fracture.other: He favours the place and keeps the weight off it.
plaguecore.health.mark.fracture.cleric: The bone is broken. Without a splint it will set crooked.
plaguecore.health.mark.sprain.name: Dislocation
plaguecore.health.mark.sprain.self: The joint sits wrong, and I dare not turn it.
plaguecore.health.mark.sprain.other: The joint is twisted out of place.
plaguecore.health.mark.sprain.cleric: The joint is out of its socket. Set it and the pain will ease at once.
plaguecore.health.mark.wound.name: Wound
plaguecore.health.mark.wound.self: It pulls and throbs under the bandage. The wound is fresh.
plaguecore.health.mark.wound.other: A dark stain is spreading through his rags.
plaguecore.health.mark.wound.cleric: The wound is open and filthy. Wash it before it festers.
plaguecore.health.mark.burn.name: Burn
plaguecore.health.mark.burn.self: The skin burns and tightens. I cannot bear to touch it.
plaguecore.health.mark.burn.other: His skin is drawn tight and shines where it burned.
plaguecore.health.mark.burn.cleric: A deep burn. The skin will come away, and soon.
plaguecore.health.mark.frostbite.name: Frostbite
plaguecore.health.mark.frostbite.self: I feel neither cold nor touch there. Only dead weight.
plaguecore.health.mark.frostbite.other: His skin is waxy and strangely white.
plaguecore.health.mark.frostbite.cleric: The flesh is frozen. Warm it slowly, or it will be worse.
plaguecore.health.mark.fever.name: Fever
plaguecore.health.mark.fever.self: I am shaking, and the heat tangles my thoughts.
plaguecore.health.mark.fever.other: Chills run through him, and his brow is damp.
plaguecore.health.mark.fever.cleric: The fever is high. He will be raving by nightfall.
plaguecore.health.mark.bleeding.name: Blood loss
plaguecore.health.mark.bleeding.self: My sight darkens and the ground tilts under me.
plaguecore.health.mark.bleeding.other: He is grey in the face and leans on the wall.
plaguecore.health.mark.bleeding.cleric: He has lost too much blood. He must not stand.
plaguecore.health.mark.exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
plaguecore.health.mark.exhaustion.self: There is nothing left in me. Even standing is work.
plaguecore.health.mark.exhaustion.other: He is held up by stubbornness alone.
plaguecore.health.mark.exhaustion.cleric: The body has eaten itself. It needs food and days of rest.
plaguecore.health.mark.concussion.name: Concussion
plaguecore.health.mark.concussion.self: Everything swims, and sounds reach me late.
plaguecore.health.mark.concussion.other: His gaze drifts and settles on nothing.
plaguecore.health.mark.concussion.cleric: The head is struck badly. No light for him, and no noise.
plaguecore.health.mark.rot.name: Rot
plaguecore.health.mark.rot.self: I smell of sweet rot, and I cannot stop noticing it.
plaguecore.health.mark.rot.other: A sweetish smell of spoilage comes off him.
plaguecore.health.mark.rot.cleric: The flesh is rotting while he lives. Cut it away or lose all of it.
plaguecore.health.memory.better: I feel a bit better now.
plaguecore.health.memory.blackout: I don't remember what just happened.
plaguecore.health.memory.none: I haven't noticed anything about myself yet.
plaguecore.health.other.body.arms.1: His movements look a bit sluggish.
plaguecore.health.other.body.arms.3: He struggles to hold on to what he picks up.
plaguecore.health.other.body.arms.4: His hands twitch on their own.
plaguecore.health.other.body.head.2: He looks past me and answers slowly.
plaguecore.health.other.body.head.3: He seems like he's not quite here.
plaguecore.health.other.body.head.4: He looks like someone else is inside him.
plaguecore.health.other.body.legs.1: He limps slightly when he walks.
plaguecore.health.other.body.legs.3: He can barely drag his feet.
plaguecore.health.other.body.legs.4: He moves in jerks, as if being pulled.
plaguecore.health.other.body.torso.1: His breathing is a bit uneven.
plaguecore.health.other.body.torso.2: He breathes heavily and coughs now and then.
plaguecore.health.other.body.torso.4: His chest heaves, and the sound of it is unpleasant.
plaguecore.health.other.overall.3: He's clearly having a hard time.
plaguecore.health.overall.1: I feel a little worse than usual today.
plaguecore.health.overall.2: Something is wrong with me, and I don't know what.
plaguecore.health.overall.4: Something terrible is happening to me.
plaguecore.health.place.head: Head
plaguecore.health.thirst.1: I want to drink all the time.
plaguecore.health.thirst.2: I want to drink more often than usual.
plaguecore.health.title: Health status
